newsitem.title: JAPAN: Deutsche Telekom softens in active Tokyo trade.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche Telekom softens in active Tokyo trade.

text.p: Shares in German telecommunications giant Deutsche Telekom softened on Tuesday morning in Tokyo but trading of the shares was very active.

Deutsche Telekom shares, which made their debut on the Tokyo Stock Exchange (TSE) earlier on Tuesday, fell as low as 2,430 yen 10 minutes after the opening. Their initial price on the market was 2,500 yen.
The total volume of Deutsche Telekom shares traded during the first 30 minutes reached more than 3.4 million shares.
The shares were trading at 2,470 yen at 0054 GMT. Turnover was more than 4.32 million shares.

The shares were first listed on the Frankfurt stock exchange priced at 28.5 marks. They started trade on Monday at a 16.5 percent premium and closed at 33.90 marks, with about 38 million shares traded.
Trade on Wall Street was also heady, with the issue closing 14 percent higher at 2-39/64 above the $21-1/2 pricing and with 17 million shares traded.
